donate.title: Support BackSubtract
donate.body: BackSubtract is free, with no ads and no sign-up. If it saved you some time, a small tip helps keep it running.
donate.note: Payments are handled securely by Stripe in a new tab. Tips are voluntary and not tax-deductible.

about.title: About BackSubtract
about.intro: A simple, free tool for removing the background from photos. Open an image, remove the background with one of a few tools, and download the result.
about.privacy: Everything happens in your browser. Your images are never uploaded, and nothing is collected. The AI models are downloaded once and kept on your device.

shortcuts.cancel: Cancel the line or shape being drawn
shortcuts.line: Brush: straight line from where the last stroke ended
